(BY SHRI NAVAL KISHOR GUPTA-ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C seeking anticipatory bail, as the applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.15/2002 registered at Police Station EOW,
Gwalior, District Gwalior (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of IPC.

Prosecution case in brief is that applicant being owner of M/s Gauri Trading Company submitted an application before Krishi Mandi Dabra for grant of permit to transport wheat, with forged and fabricated receipt bearing No.119/2005 dated 07.06.2001 and obtained the said permit.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that it has been alleged against the applicant that he submitted forged and fabricated receipt amounting Rs.1760/- and obtained the permit to transport wheat from Krishi Mandi Dabra.

He further submits that the matter relates to the year 2002,
wherein after investigation, charge-sheet was filed in the year 2013 and during the said period

,
applicant was not residing at Dabra and had gone to Indore for doing business.

He was not informed about the filing of charge-sheet and bailable warrant issued against him by the Trial Court was also not served upon him and thereafter non- bailable warrant was issued against him.
All the other co-accused persons were enlarged on bail by the Trial Court itself.
In the light of order dated 08.05.2023, applicant has been enlarged on temporary bail by the Trial Court and he has not misused the liberty.

Under such circumstances,
applicant is entitled for grant of anticipatory bail.

Learned Public Prosecutor for the State has opposed the prayer and submits that applicant was very well aware about the fact that charge sheet was filed against him, as the bailable warrant issued against him by the Trial Court was served upon him.
He was absconding for more than ten years

,
therefore, no case is made out for grant of anticipatory bail.
Having considered the rival submissions, nature of allegations alleged against the applicant, amount of receipt which is said to be forged and also considering that the matter relates to year 2002 and charge sheet was filed in the year 2013, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.
It is directed that on applicant's surrendering before the trial Court and thereafter on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court, he be released on bail, subject to condition that he shall remain always present before the trial court as and when called and comply with the conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
M.Cr.C. stands disposed of, accordingly.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
(SATYENDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE Aman Akhilesh Shihare vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48820425/
